info.description: Documentation for Web DU Backend API.
info.title: Web DU Backend

post.description: Upload and update authenticated user's avatar image. Only authenticated users can access this endpoint.

parameters.description: Avatar image file (max 5MB, supported: JPG, PNG, GIF)
parameters.name: avatar

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of courses with optional filters (mentor_id, title, price, is_premium)
get.summary: Get all courses with pagination and filters

post.description: Create a new course with details and optional thumbnail. Admin only.

parameters.description: Course slug (unique identifier, lowercase with hyphens)
parameters.name: slug

get.description: Retrieve complete information of a specific course including all modules

post.description: Allow authenticated students to enroll in a course. Creates an enrollment record.

get.description: Retrieve all lessons with optional module_id filter. Admin only.

post.description: Create a new lesson for a module. Admin only. Requires module_id and title. Content and video_url are optional.

parameters.description: Lesson data with module_id, title, content
parameters.name: request

get.description: Retrieve detailed information of a specific lesson. Admin only.

put.description: Update an existing lesson by ID. Admin only. All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated.

delete.description: Delete a lesson by ID (Admin only)

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password, returns JWT token valid for 24 hours
Create a new module in a course (Admin only)

404.description: Course not found or User not found

get.description: Retrieve all modules for a specific course ordered by sequence
Retrieve a specific module with all its lessons

put.description: Update an existing module's information. Admin only.

delete.description: Delete a module and all its associated lessons. Admin only.

get.description: Initiates Google OAuth 2.0 authentication flow. Redirects user to Google consent screen.

307.description: Redirect to Google OAuth consent screen

get.description: Handles OAuth callback from Google. Exchanges authorization code for token and creates/updates user account.

parameters.description: OAuth state parameter for CSRF protection
parameters.name: state

200.description: User logged in via Google successfully

get.description: Get payment details by payment reference

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing JWT token

post.description: Create a new payment request to Tripay for a course enrollment

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing JWT token

post.description: Register a new user with name, email, and password. Returns JWT token on success.

get.description: Retrieve current authenticated user's complete profile including personal data and enrolled courses

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing JWT token

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of all users with optional filtering by role and search. Supports sorting by created_at or name. Admin only.
get.summary: Get all users with pagination (Admin only)

parameters.description: Sort order: asc or desc (default: desc)
parameters.name: order

200.description: Users retrieved successfully with pagination metadata

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - Only admins can access this endpoint

delete.description: Delete a user account permanently. Only administrators can perform this action. Admins cannot delete their own account.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - Only admins can delete users

patch.description: Update a specific user's role. Only administrators can perform this action. Valid roles are: admin, mentor, student.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - Only admins can update roles

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
